description: This file defines configuration parsing logic for 'Talk Mode Gateway' in an Android application, including a data class representing the configuration state and a parser object with functions for extracting and validating configuration values from JSON objects.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Data class representing the state/configuration for Talk Mode Gateway, including session key, interrupt flag, and silence timeout.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON object into a TalkModeGatewayConfigState instance, extracting session configuration and other parameters.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the silence timeout in milliseconds from the JSON configuration, falling back to a default if invalid or absent.
